candidates.name: Bullous pemphigoid
support_spans: Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva.
Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum.
candidates.why: The patient presents with progressive, painful blisters and ulcers of the groin, which is consistent with bullous pemphigoid.

candidates.name: Amyloidosis
support_spans: Macroglossia, glossitis, and a hemorrhagic erosion on the hard palate.
Purpuric macules present periorbitally, on the lips, inframammary folds, forearms, and thighs.
candidates.why: The patient's macroglossia and purpuric macules are consistent with amyloidosis, particularly in the context of her multiple myeloma.

candidates.name: Amyloid light-chain amyloidosis
support_spans: IgG λ-type multiple myeloma complicated by anemia and lytic lesions in the calvarium
candidates.why: The patient's multiple myeloma and associated symptoms are consistent with amyloid light-chain amyloidosis.

candidates.name: Paraneoplastic pemphigus
support_spans: Circinate purpuric patches with erosions on the natal cleft, buttocks, inguinal creases, and vulva.
Hemorrhagic flaccid bullae on the posterior perineum.
candidates.why: The patient's blistering skin lesions and underlying multiple myeloma are consistent with paraneoplastic pemphigus.

candidates.name: Amyloidosis
support_spans: Repeated biopsy from left groin showed subepidermal blister lined by fibrin and chronic inflammatory infiltrate, with scattered short eosinophilic bands in the dermis showing apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining
candidates.why: The biopsy findings of apple-green birefringence on polarized light microscopy with Congo red staining are diagnostic of amyloidosis.

candidates.name: Bullous pemphigoid
support_spans: Direct immunofluorescence test was negative
candidates.why: The negative direct immunofluorescence test does not rule out bullous pemphigoid, and further testing such as ELISA or Western blot may be necessary for diagnosis.
